title: Big Bubble No-Knead Focaccia
description: A light, airy Italian focaccia with a crispy olive oil crust and signature large bubbles. No kneading or stand mixer required—just four stretch-and-folds and an overnight cold proof.
steps: In a large bowl whisk together the warm water, salt, olive oil, and yeast.
Add the flour and mix with a spoon or spatula until no dry flour remains. The dough should be very wet and sticky.
Cover the bowl and let the dough rest for 30 minutes.
Perform the first stretch-and-fold: pull one side of the dough upward and fold it over itself. Rotate the bowl 90° and repeat until all four sides have been folded.
Cover and rest for another 30 minutes.
Repeat the stretch-and-fold process three more times, resting 30 minutes between each round (4 total rounds).
Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight for 12–24 hours. This cold fermentation develops flavor and creates the signature large bubbles.
Generously oil a 9×13-inch (23×33 cm) baking tray with extra virgin olive oil.
Transfer the cold dough into the tray, turning it once so both sides are lightly coated in oil.
Cover and let the dough proof at room temperature for about 2 hours, or until relaxed and nearly doubled in size.
Drizzle the surface generously with olive oil.
Oil your fingertips and gently dimple the dough without pressing all the air out. Stretch the dough toward the corners only if necessary.
Add rosemary, olives, flaky sea salt, or your favorite toppings.
Bake in a preheated 400°F (200°C) convection oven (425°F / 220°C conventional) for 20–25 minutes until deep golden brown with crisp edges.
Allow the focaccia to cool for 10–15 minutes before slicing.
notes: Italian 00 flour with about 12% protein gives the lightest, airiest crumb.
If your flour absorbs more water, add a splash of additional water until the dough is very wet and sticky.
Do not skip the overnight cold proof—it greatly improves flavor, gluten development, and bubble formation.
Use plenty of olive oil. It is responsible for the crispy crust and classic focaccia flavor.
Excellent toppings include cherry tomatoes, caramelized onions, roasted garlic, Parmesan, mozzarella, olives, rosemary, thyme, or pesto.
Slice horizontally for outstanding sandwiches with prosciutto, mozzarella, pesto, grilled vegetables, or chicken.
